title: PublicOutputInsightResponse
description: Response for GET /api/dashboards/:dashboardId/panels/:panelId/insight (HEL-1742, public / optional-auth, same dashboard gate and ?token= as the history route). An allowlist: the newest ok render's markdown, creation time and citations reduced to id, field, number, date, capturedAt and isPct, plus an optional panelId (HEL-1744): the id of a panel on this same dashboard bound to the cited Output, chosen deterministically (lowest panel id), present only when such a panel exists. It never carries cost, model, token counts, a run id, the input digest, the trigger, a row id, an attempt status or a cited Output id. render is null when the insight Output has no ok render yet.
